info.description: RecipeBase is a recipe API whose list, search, and similarity endpoints actually work. The best-known recipe API on this marketplace (17,905 subscribers, rated 2/5) leaves 20+ Discussion threads unanswered about recipes/list and recipes/list-similarities not working and a search that misses what callers type; the other big recipe API's threads carry the same story: 404s, searches returning nothing, 401s. RecipeBase answers in the product: a paginated list with working category, diet, country, and difficulty filters; a similarities endpoint ranked by shared ingredients, category, and cuisine; and search that is case-insensitive with partial-keyword matching across names, summaries, and ingredients, so CARB, Carbon, and carbonara all find the carbonara. An empty search returns a valid 200 response with count 0, never an error, and every failure is a structured JSON object that names the problem. The catalog is stated honestly: 501 curated world recipes from 127 countries (UniTools World Recipes, CC BY-SA 4.0, credited in every response), with ingredients, timed steps, a servings scaler driven by the dataset's own scaling rules, and photos served only with the per-photo author and license the data provides. Nutrition is computed from ingredients and labeled a planning reference, not lab-measured. Pricing: the incumbent's $10 entry tier is free here (Pro $0), Ultra $20 against their $30, Mega $290 against their $300, all hard limits.
